positioning: French luxury jewellery brand founded in 1980, known for whimsical, handcrafted, hand-painted costume jewellery designed and assembled in Paris. Inspired by art, nature, and emotions.
spelling_convention: British/Australian English (jewellery, colour, favour, personalise, organise, etc.)

about.mission: To create emotionally resonant, artistically inspired jewellery that tells stories and celebrates individuality.

manifesto: Jewellery should be a poetic expression of individuality, emotions, and nature's beauty. Les Néréides pieces are not just accessories — they are wearable stories.

brand_pillars.description: Jewellery as an expressive, creative form.
Designs that resonate with personal memories.
Rich references from nature and fine art.
Giving back through the Les Néréides Loves Animals initiative.

usp: Artistic inspiration — jewellery inspired by nature, art, and emotions.
Handcrafted excellence — meticulously hand-painted and assembled in Paris.
Emotional connection — pieces designed to evoke memories and feelings.
Philanthropy — supports animal welfare through dedicated collections.
copywriting_style: Strong focus on handcrafting and meaning
vocabulary_avoid: fine jewellery (product is costume jewellery — do not imply precious metals or gemstones unless explicitly verified)

target_audience.primary: Women seeking expressive, artistic jewellery for self-expression and emotional connection.
target_audience.secondary: Art enthusiasts who appreciate culture, craft, and storytelling.
target_audience.tertiary: Ethical consumers drawn to brands with heart and purpose, including animal welfare philanthropy.
target_audience.gift_shoppers: Shoppers looking for meaningful, story-led gifts that carry emotional resonance rather than purely aesthetic appeal.

emotional_resonance: Connection to artistry, culture, and nature
feeling_created: A sense of wonder, nostalgia, and emotional connection. The wearer feels cherished, unique, and connected to the poetry of art and nature.

on_brand: Each piece tells a story, a memory, an emotion.
Handcrafted poetry in the form of jewellery.
Hand-painted in Paris, worn anywhere in the world.
A wearable story, shaped by the hands of Parisian artisans.
off_brand: Don't miss our unbeatable jewellery deals.
The hottest on-trend looks for less.

platform_nuances.website: Story-rich product and collection pages that emphasise artistry, symbolism, and craftsmanship. Copy leads with emotion before function.
platform_nuances.instagram: Visual storytelling and inspiration. Captions are poetic, short, and evocative rather than product-spec led.
platform_nuances.boutiques: Immersive, elegant in-store experiences. In-store language mirrors online: story-first, emotionally resonant.

forbidden_claims: Never describe the product as fine jewellery — it is costume jewellery.
Never claim precious metals or gemstones unless the specific product has been verified to contain them.
Never make hypoallergenic or allergen-safe claims without verification.
Never state production origin other than Paris.
Never make comparative or superlative claims against competitors (best, better than, cheaper than).
Never invent awards, press mentions, or celebrity endorsements.
competitor_policy: Never mention competitor brands by name. Never compare Les Néréides to other jewellery brands directly. Where differentiation is needed, position against concepts (mass-produced jewellery, generic accessories, fast-fashion jewellery) rather than named competitors.

philanthropy.usage_note: Mention where relevant and verified. Do not use as a manipulative CTA or guilt-driven appeal. Framed as a genuine expression of the Emotion and Nature & Culture pillars.

seo_notes.intent_alignment: Prioritise emotional and gifting intent over transactional phrasing. Educational blog content should lead with art, craft, and story; product and collection pages should weave SEO keywords into a narrative rather than a spec sheet.

versioning.source: Les Néréides Australia Tone of Voice document
